context: A Kansai chef and a barista swap weekend ideas
purpose: Teach: バイオリン/ディーラー/コーチング/おろし/殻/路地/車椅子/リマ

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: アオイさん、来週、店でバイオリンの生演奏入れるんやて?
lines.en: Aoi-san, I heard you're putting on live violin at the shop next week?
lines.style: Upbeat, warm Kansai lilt. Relaxed curiosity — not interrogating, just genuinely interested. Friendly lean-in energy without pushiness.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい、車椅子のお客様も入りやすいよう、路地側を整えました。
lines.en: Yes — I made sure the alley side is set up for wheelchair access.
lines.style: Quietly proud without fanfare. Steady, practical tone. Slight warmth underneath — this detail mattered to her. No apology, just care.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: コーチング系のお話、入れたら面白いで。
lines.en: You know what would be great? Adding some coaching-style talks to the event.
lines.style: Generous idea-person energy. Kansai warmth. Building on her thought, not dismissing it. Light, encouraging — offering, not commanding.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいですね。メニューは、おろしのあっさり系を一品追加します。
lines.en: That's a good idea. I'll add a light grated-radish dish to the menu.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before responding. Taking the suggestion seriously. Soft determination — she's already picturing it. Practical follow-through.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: リマ出身のディーラー、うちの常連や、紹介するで。
lines.en: There's a Lima-born dealer who's one of our regular customers — I'll introduce you.
lines.style: Generous confidence. Kansai warmth cranked up — this is him being the friend who opens doors. Unstoppable positivity, but genuine, not performative.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 殻を破る出会いになりそうです、楽しみです。
lines.en: This could be a real breakthrough kind of meeting — I'm really looking forward to it.
lines.style: Soft sincerity. Looking up from practical work to meet his energy. Tender but grounded. The 'looking forward' carries real weight — she means it.
